pitfalls.title: Max Send is not a per-trip amount or per-route quota
pitfalls.correction: It is a shared cap on the destination's stock including in-flight deliveries.

pitfalls.title: Changing Max Send on one route changes it for every origin
pitfalls.correction: The value lives on the destination per product; all suppliers of that product to that destination share it.

evidence.note: B and C changed with A

pitfalls.title: Max Send 0 means unlimited, not zero
pitfalls.correction: The UI shows infinity; the stored value is 0.

pitfalls.title: Min Keep 'keep all' stops the route entirely
pitfalls.correction: A keep-all Min Keep means the route never dispatches.

pitfalls.title: Shop demand is per consumption interval, not per month
pitfalls.correction: Scale by 30 / consumption_interval_days for a monthly figure.

pitfalls.title: Code defaults are not the game's values
pitfalls.correction: Asset values win: upkeep 0.025 (not 0.25), efficiency arrays {0.25..2}, initial index 3, 3 modules (catalogue maximum; research raises it, live validation saw 5 on every hub), 8 shop products, research queue 9, market update every 15 days.

pitfalls.title: A dispatch amount is not throughput
pitfalls.correction: dispatch_amount_now is what the next dispatch would request now; scheduler, vehicles and priorities decide real flow.

pitfalls.title: Dispatch cost is per vehicle dispatch, not per unit
pitfalls.correction: A half-empty vehicle costs as much as a full one; divide by capacity for a per-unit figure.

evidence.note: per vehicle dispatch, not per unit

pitfalls.title: Routes of an AUTO_WH building are dormant
pitfalls.correction: Their slots still exist but do not dispatch.

pitfalls.title: AI cash is meaningless
pitfalls.correction: AI companies have infinite money; compare them by buildings, regions and production instead.

pitfalls.title: There is no market price history
pitfalls.correction: Only current prices and trends exist; do not infer past prices.

evidence.note: market price history does not exist

pitfalls.title: There is no daily ledger and no per-route history
pitfalls.correction: Finances are monthly aggregates; routes keep no history.

evidence.note: no daily money ledger; no per-route history

pitfalls.title: There are no wages
pitfalls.correction: The efficiency slider is the equivalent; it scales output and upkeep together.

pitfalls.title: Display names are not identifiers
pitfalls.correction: Names are localized, user-editable and duplicated ('FACTORY 5' exists per owner); use ids.

pitfalls.title: Recipe game days are not the effective cycle time
pitfalls.correction: Efficiency and company modifiers change the speed; use cycle_days_effective.

pitfalls.title: Route distance 0 means no cached path
pitfalls.correction: It is not a zero-length route; the MCP reports null with path_status unavailable.

evidence.note: game value 0 means no cached path

pitfalls.title: A straight-line cost estimate is not a route
pitfalls.correction: straight_line_cost_estimate is non-authoritative and exists only where no route is known.

pitfalls.title: Selling to the State pays the base price
pitfalls.correction: The State pays the base price without the market modifier.

evidence.note: base price, without the market modifier

pitfalls.title: Cancelling research refunds nothing
pitfalls.correction: Money already spent on a cancelled research is lost.

pitfalls.title: Cash is not part of company value
pitfalls.correction: Company value counts owned regions only.

evidence.note: cash is not part of company value

pitfalls.title: Advisor estimates are estimates
pitfalls.correction: Advisor numbers marked kind=estimate rely on the listed assumptions; check confidence and assumptions before acting.
